instruction.text: Drag the phrases to the correct form of the present tense.

trainers.hint:
The progressive present describes an action that is happening right now. For example, “I am running to the park.”
The simple present is used for things that happen often, wishes and unchanging situations. For example, “I visit my dad every Friday.”
